Opus critic, prototype on the real tutil, both gawk versions (5.0.0 / 5.4.0), every probe with stdin closed. BLOCKER: -e '' is dropped by gawk and the first path becomes the program (a path named 1 hung reading stdin) -> empty chunks never emitted, no-program rc 2, apply '' rc 2. MAJORS: -W long-option spelling bypassed the deny-list and a dangling -W swallowed the generated prologue; a non-option extra becomes THE program; -o -g -h -V -C -d -p -D skip the program, write files under the sandbox, print to stdout or hang; 5.4 + sandbox + -M loses the input; -i inplace resolves through AWKPATH (. first) so a planted ./inplace.awk ran with the sandbox off -> absolute include path; a missing input file is FATAL (later files never read or edited); and -v with doubled backslashes DOES round-trip — the supervisor re-checked through a file and confirmed it (the planning probe had been corrupted by the Bash tool collapsing backslashes in an inline command), with one extra rule found in the re-check: newline as \n. The env + prologue design was dropped. MINOR/NIT: indexed var storage (hash order), keyword/builtin names refused, namespaced assignment operands, a fuller sandbox list, in-place traps (exit truncates, END to stdout, ENDFILE into the file), BINMODE disabled by --posix/-c, programFile via AWKPATH and -f -, version-dependent abbreviations (refuse any prefix), chunks cannot span -e words, callback trap, the directory warning identical on both.

Owner: push, then tawk. Two gawk versions measured (5.0.0 under bash 5.2.37 via Git for Windows, 5.4.0 under 5.3.9 via msys64), behaviour identical except messages and INPLACE_SUFFIX. Facts: -e/-f concatenate in argument order; no program -> the first operand is the program and stdin may be read (the planning probe HUNG on `gawk '{print FILENAME}' k=v` — an assignment operand, not a file); rc 1 syntax/fatal, 2 missing input (partial) / missing -f / sandbox fatal, exit N mod 256, a directory is skipped with a warning (rc 0); -v processes escapes and backslash doubling does not round-trip, ENVIRON is verbatim; text mode strips CR, BINMODE=3 keeps it; RS NUL needs ORS NUL for NUL output; print terminates an unterminated last line; --sandbox refuses system/redirection/pipes AND extensions, so -i inplace needs sandbox off; inplace::suffix works on both versions. Owner decided: sandbox as sed (on, fail-closed); setVar verbatim; model and rc as sed; in-place as sed. PLAN.md + this ledger written. No code.
